top_deficiency_types.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.
Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.
Ensure residents do not lose the ability to perform activities of daily living unless there is a medical reason.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure menus must meet the nutritional needs of residents, be prepared in advance, be followed, be updated, be reviewed by dietician, and meet the needs of the resident.
Ensure food and drink is palatable, attractive, and at a safe and appetizing temperature.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
